title: Cash & Deposits
description: Every cash-balance account — checking, savings, CDs, cash-modelled bonds — with balance, rate, and maturity. Accounts tagged with an asset-class group by type; untagged accounts show as plain cash. Nothing is hidden.

widgets.title: Total Cash & Deposits
widgets.helpText: Sum of all your cash-balance accounts (checking, savings, CDs, cash-modelled bonds), per currency. Priced holdings are on the Holdings dashboard, not here.

steps.query: SELECT ab.currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(ab.balance AS REAL)), 2) AS amount FROM account_balances ab JOIN commodities cc ON cc.code = ab.currency AND cc.is_currency = 1 WHERE ab.account LIKE 'Assets:%' AND (:currency = '*' OR ab.currency = :currency) GROUP BY ab.currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY ab.currency

widgets.title: Unattributed Interest
widgets.helpText: Interest that could not be tied to the instrument that earned it — per currency. This happens when interest is paid out to a separate account and the earning instrument declares no interest_account link. It is still counted in your income totals; it just can't be assigned a yield. Add an interest_account to the earning account's open to attribute it. When everything is attributed, this shows nothing.

widgets.title: Accounts
widgets.helpText: Every cash-balance account with its type, rate, maturity, interest earned, and effective yield (interest ÷ average balance, annualized). Interest is attributed to the account that earned it — even when paid out (via the account's interest_account) or at maturity; interest that can't be tied to an account shows as a "Unattributed interest" row. Tag an account's open with asset-class (checking/savings/cd/bond) to type it.

visualization.emptyText: No cash-balance accounts in this currency.

widgets.title: Cash by Type
widgets.helpText: Your cash-balance accounts by type, in the selected currency. Untagged accounts fall under "cash".

steps.query: SELECT type AS name, ROUND(SUM(CAST(ab.balance AS REAL)), 2) AS value FROM (SELECT ab.account, ab.balance, COALESCE(json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$."asset-class"'), 'cash') AS type, ab.currency FROM account_balances ab JOIN accounts a ON a.name = ab.account JOIN commodities cc ON cc.code = ab.currency AND cc.is_currency = 1 WHERE ab.account LIKE 'Assets:%' AND ab.currency = :currency) ab GROUP BY type HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC

visualization.emptyText: No cash-balance accounts in this currency.

widgets.title: Upcoming Maturities
widgets.helpText: Term instruments (CDs, bonds) with a recorded maturity date, soonest first.

steps.query: SELECT ab.account AS account, ab.currency AS currency, json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$.interest_rate') AS rate, json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$.maturity_date') AS maturity, ROUND(CAST(ab.balance AS REAL), 2) AS balance FROM account_balances ab JOIN accounts a ON a.name = ab.account WHERE ab.account LIKE 'Assets:%' AND (:currency = '*' OR ab.currency = :currency) AND json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$.maturity_date') IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ab.balance AS REAL) != 0 ORDER BY maturity

visualization.emptyText: No term instruments with a recorded maturity date. Add maturity_date to a CD/bond account's open to see it here.
